name: Citabria / Decathlon / Scout
summary: Family of tandem two-seat tube-and-fabric taildraggers used for tailwheel and aerobatic training, glider towing and backcountry flying.

wings: Straight constant-chord wing with squared-off tips
engines: Single flat-four in an enclosed cowl
fuselage: Narrow tandem two-seat fabric-covered fuselage with a door on the right
Tailwheel gear with spring-steel or aluminum main legs (no strut vee)
tail: Squared-off fin and rudder with straight edges

tellTales: Tandem two-seat high-wing taildragger with a squared-off tail
Plain spring-steel main gear legs rather than a strut vee

confusedWith.howToTell: The Super Cub has a rounded tail and a strut-braced gear vee; the Citabria has a squared tail and spring-steel legs.
The Champ has a rounded tail and rounded wingtips with a deeper forward fuselage; the Citabria's tail and wingtips are squared.
The J-3 has a rounded tail, exposed engine cylinders and a V-strut gear; the Citabria has a squared tail and a closed cowl.
